I replied to Marcus in his thread in #north-random. I noted the Thornbury Cloth Co. signed order form deadline as 15 August. This replaces the 24 December date he posted in #north-team earlier today. My reply in #north-random doesn't repeat the old date.

I also asked him one thing: it's 14 October now, so 15 August has already passed. I asked whether the ops lead meant 15 August next year or whether the deadline has actually lapsed. As he asked, I took no other action.
